text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr's withdrawal from the
tryouts hit me just the day
before the race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nngh, my leg... Why? Why do I... keep
doing this?

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Goodness... why were you doing such
high-stress training? Of course you'd get
hurt, running like that. Races are off the
table until you
recover.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, I've got to run in the tryouts. Mortal
hands cannot stop the rising
wind.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I'll not hear any of that nonsense.
Listen. If
you try to run now, there's
a good chance
you'll never run again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But the wind cannot stop moving—for in
stillness, it dies away. What
am I, if not the
wind coursing over the track?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's sparks of something dangerous in
her stormy resolve. For her
sake, I suggest
spending her recovery off-campus, well
away from Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I first met her, she told me that
feeling the wind eased her heart when she
was stressed. There's a good sports rehab
center in the countryside that might be
just what she needs.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It must be starting—the other runners are
taking off down the track,
fighting to
become the wind... And then there's me.
What am I doing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's here to recover.
It'd be a waste to let
this soothing breeze pass
her by while her
heart's somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Wild Bird
text_block_list.text: Chee-cheep, chee-cheep, chee-cheep.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...That sounded like a little Necktie
bird.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And look,
he's sitting right up there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perched on a nearby branch, there's a tit
with a big stripe pattern
down its neck. At
the very least, the name is... apt?
Compared to Daruma the thrush.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't even notice all the birds until
just
now. The bitter, wintry
howl in my heart
must have drowned them out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gazes at the bird,
eyes finally focused
on the world in front of
her. If I can find
more things to keep her attention here,
maybe it'd lift the weight on her heart.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... the breeze here is so lovely.
It feels
like it's sweeping away all
my worries.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I think I am.
I'm sorry for the trouble,
Trainer. To think I let my mind get batted
around by hailstorms in summer... Oh, it's
so embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The scenery here takes me back, though. I
wasn't in the soundest of
health as a child, you see,
so I spent a lot of time out in the 
countryside's fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was friends with all the little birds
and woodland creatures. I'd spend each day
listening to them sing,
enjoying the idyllic
life.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And yet, there was a thought in the back
of my mind: that I was weaker than even
the softest breeze. Too slow to cause so
much as
ripples in my wake.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I would wish with all my heart... that one
day, I'd become the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'd be lighthearted and free, yet strong.
And like the wind... no one
would be able
to hold me back.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind was everything my body wasn't,
and... oh, how I dreamed of
being able to
run the way it did.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But that's all it was back then—a bunch of
daydreams. I never thought
it remotely
possible until one day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to watch a race, and... I
saw the wind incarnate. I saw
her soar
across the track.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Her strides rose a gale, a current
rushing over the land. All the shapeless
fantasies I'd held suddenly took shape
into
a solid goal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then, a thought hit me. That perhaps the
runner's transformation was exclusive to
the track. That only in races could one
truly become the
wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But what am I saying? I've never shared
that story with anyone, but...
for some
reason, it feels like I could tell you
anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess that means we've built up some
trust together. If she's
comfortable with
me, then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I don't know what I've done to earn this much of your time, but the winds do work in mysterious ways. A ship can't begrudge that which fills its sails.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I would be most grateful, Trainer. Your
words really do coast upon the
gentlest
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, our path to her recovery
begins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the best shot at a smooth return to
racing, we want to keep up with her
training without stressing her injury. I'm
going to start by
strengthening her core.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Focus on my positioning... Keep my
movements precise. Control even the tips
of my fingers and toes... and harness the
storm with my inner
muscles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pool training is the perfect way to apply
pressure evenly to her body
without
straining her joints.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Glide like the wind over the shoreline,
sharp and quiet as an
assassin...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meals are an important aspect of physical
therapy too. She needs protein to
counteract the injury. I've got her on a
meal plan that's light on carbs and
includes a healthy balance of vitamins.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... The filling taste of the sea breeze
on my tongue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And of course, the most important thing is
rest. I make sure to
schedule plenty of
de-stress time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, there's a whole line of Matcha
mochis here. The way you're snuggled up
as little borbs,
it's like a breeze could roll
you all away. Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I finished the routine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her recovery's been going smoothly. It
shouldn't be long before we've
got her
back on the track.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I, um... I have to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm no trainer,
but even I can tell that my
recovery's going wonderfully. It's worlds
better than what I was doing about
injuries before...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind isn't laden down with heavy
thoughts—no worries, fears, or
greed... So I
don't want them weighing me down on the
track either.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
When I run, the only thing on my mind
should be... the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And yet, with every injury,
I left my heart exposed to gusts of bitter
cold. Battered
into the ground, unable to join the
slipstream...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think...
that probably explains the rumors
of her being "passive."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been putting a lot of willpower into
maintaining a light outlook,
in spite of her
injury and withdrawal from the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her calm demeanor isn't from a lack of ambition. It's from her resolve to run unshackled like the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But now, you're here, sheltering me from
the ominous chills in the air.
I cannot
express my gratitude enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Behind all the wind analogies, Yamanin
Zephyr is actually pretty straightforward.
With passion like hers,
I'm sure she really will become
the wind in a big race someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, her determination is a
double-edged sword. The more power she
gains, the more likely she is to
inadvertently hurt herself with it. She
needs guidance.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What a sudden gust. But... not an
unpleasant one.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I certainly did hope that if I ever got
scouted, it'd be by someone like
you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However...
I'm afraid I'll have to decline.
